picai_nnunet_supervised_bpmri.description: PI-CAI supervised baseline checkpoints for clinically significant prostate cancer (ISUP Grade Group ≥2). These are not the final consortium system; the model card lists no performance for these checkpoints. Five folds, T2W/ADC/HBV channels, published voxel crop and dynamic lesion extraction.
picai_nnunet_supervised_bpmri.structures: Up to five csPCa lesion candidates, each with a model likelihood
picai_nnunet_supervised_bpmri.license_note: Non-commercial, share-alike weight licence; code Apache-2.0.
picai_nnunet_supervised_bpmri.status: Not enabled: on our GPUs the lowest-scoring lesion candidate in the authors' public example differs in extent from their reference output (390 vs 1,132 voxels), outside the authors' reproduction tolerance. The semi-supervised PI-CAI model passed the same checks and is available.

umu_prostate_zones_urethra_t2.description: Umeå five-fold T2 prostate zone model. Urethra_6mm_model is a constructed 6-mm-diameter structure, not the urethral lumen. Published median centreline distances were 2.8 and 2.9 mm against two raters, compared with 3.6 mm between raters. The study included 40 double-read test cases and 55 external cases. The published circle requires equal in-plane voxel spacing.
umu_prostate_zones_urethra_t2.structures: Peripheral, central, transition and anterior fibromuscular zones; constructed 6-mm urethra
umu_prostate_zones_urethra_t2.license_note: Weight licence not stated by the authors; repository code MIT.

prostate158_tumor_bpmri.description: Original Prostate158 three-channel tumour UNet. T2W, ADC and DWI are mapped to t2w, adc and hbv roles. The author model description reports tumour Dice 0.453/0.398 against two readers on 19 test cases. Argmax and largest-component postprocessing retain one tumour component; this is not a multifocal detector.
prostate158_tumor_bpmri.license_note: Weights CC BY 4.0; original source code MIT.

nci_monai_prostate_lesion_bpmri.description: Segments the prostate and lesion candidates from axial T2W, ADC and high b-value DWI. Each lesion receives a model PI-RADS class (2–5). External evaluation in 151 patients reported csPCa examination-level AUROC 0.78 (95% CI 0.71–0.86), sensitivity 0.87 and specificity 0.53. Research use only: the licence excludes diagnosis and treatment.
nci_monai_prostate_lesion_bpmri.structures: NCI_Prostate and one NCI_L##_PIRADS2–5 ROI per lesion; no fixed maximum lesion count
nci_monai_prostate_lesion_bpmri.license_note: Research use only: the licence excludes diagnosis and treatment. Owner accepted these terms on 2026-10-22
nci_monai_prostate_lesion_bpmri.status: GPU reference and DICOM acceptance pending

umambamtl_cspca_bpmri.description: Detects up to three clinically significant prostate cancer candidates from axial T2W, ADC and high b-value DWI. Lesion and examination likelihoods are model scores. The released architecture has two decoders. The paper reports AUROC 0.843 and average precision 0.622 for MTL-Dual in 100 PI-CAI hidden tuning cases; AUROC 0.925 and average precision 0.685 in 200 institutional examinations. The auxiliary zone head gates detection; no zone ROIs are exported. Runs on the H100 worker.
umambamtl_cspca_bpmri.structures: Up to three UMMTL_L##_p0.73 lesion ROIs; full-precision scores in JSON
umambamtl_cspca_bpmri.license: Repository Apache-2.0; weight licence not stated
